correctness.rationale: For each uv outside selected edges F of K_n, exactly d_F(u)+d_F(v) adjacent vertices lie in F in T_n. Hence the fort condition is equivalent to the absence of simultaneous isolated and degree-one vertices in H=([n],F). If H has an isolate, the no-leaf condition forces a cycle, whose edge set is itself a nonspanning fort; inclusion-minimality forces exactly that one simple cycle. If H has no isolates, F is a spanning edge cover, and minimality implies each edge meets a degree-one vertex, equivalent to each component being a star. Conversely every such cycle and star forest is a minimal fort, checking all nonempty proper subsets. A size-m star contributes m z^(m-1) u^m/m! for m>=3 and zu^2/2 for m=2, giving the proposed EGF; nonspanning unoriented k-cycles contribute binom(n,k)(k-1)!/2. Boundary n=3 has three size-two stars, n=4 has three K2 unions plus four stars and four triangles, and n>=5 starts at size three. The gap-free spectrum, maximum n-1 and n+n!/(2(n-1)) largest-count formula follow. Independent direct adjacency/fort enumeration of all 8,64,1024,32768 subsets for n=3..6 agrees with 3,11,60,308 minimal forts, and independent labeled component recurrence agrees through n=15; these finite checks do not establish the infinite result, which follows from the structural proof.
